NSAppleEventsUsageDescription
Claude needs this so commands you run in Claude can control other apps.
Claude 需要这项权限，以便你在 Claude 中运行的命令可以控制其他应用。
NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription
This app needs access to audio capture
Claude 需要音频采集权限。
NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription
Claude uses Bluetooth to connect to hardware accessories.
Claude 使用蓝牙连接硬件配件。
NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription
This app needs access to Bluetooth
Claude 需要蓝牙访问权限。
NSCameraUsageDescription
Claude needs your camera for content that you allow to use it.
Claude 需要相机权限来处理你允许使用相机的内容。
NSDesktopFolderUsageDescription
Claude needs access to work with files on your Desktop.
Claude 需要访问“桌面”文件夹，以处理其中的文件。
NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription
Claude stores your scheduled tasks, live artifacts and other Cowork files here.
Claude 在此存储你的定时任务、实时制品和其他 Cowork 文件。
NSDownloadsFolderUsageDescription
Claude needs access to work with files in your Downloads folder.
Claude 需要访问“下载”文件夹，以处理其中的文件。
NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription
Claude needs access to your local network to reach development servers and other local devices.
Claude 需要访问本地网络，以连接开发服务器和其他本地设备。
NSLocationUsageDescription
Claude needs your location for content that you allow to use it.
Claude 需要位置信息来处理你允许使用位置的内容。
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription
Claude needs your microphone for dictation and for content that you allow to use it.
Claude 需要使用麦克风进行听写，以及处理你允许使用麦克风的内容。
NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription
Claude needs access to speech recognition for voice dictation.
Claude 需要语音识别权限来进行语音听写。
